text: God has prescribed for you—O people—from the religion which We revealed to you—O Messenger, which is Islam—what He enjoined upon Noah to practice and convey, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus (these five are the resolute messengers according to the well-known view): to establish the religion through monotheism, obedience to God, and worship of Him alone, and not to differ in the religion which I have commanded you. It was great upon the polytheists what you call them to of the oneness of God and sincere worship of Him. God chooses for monotheism whom He wills from His creation, and grants success in acting in obedience to Him to whoever turns back to Him.
